description: Mark a comment thread resolved. Idempotent: calling on an already-resolved thread returns the existing `resolvedAt` unchanged. Fires `comment.resolved`. Pair with `unresolve_comment` for the reverse. Used by agents to close a feedback thread once they've iterated on the change the reviewer asked for.

comment_id.description: Comment id to resolve (use the thread root, resolving a reply targets the reply itself, not the thread).

name: resolve_comment
